name: Intro: logo door
when: The video's first seconds: an animated opening before the first shot plays plain (a gap with the reference channels: their videos open on a designed moment, never on a cold cut). The game's logo lands on the ground colours, its artwork fades and leaves a logo-shaped window onto the first shot playing underneath, then the camera dives through the window into that shot. An optional line under the logo (the video's subject in a few words) rides along.
anchor: Starts at 0 with the video. The window opens at `fill` and the dive starts at `out`: put the dive on the first strong word of the voice, or on the first beat of the music.
placement: Mount it at the very start (--start 0) over the project's first shot, which plays underneath from 0: the window shows that shot, so cut it on a calm, readable moment (a skyline, a beach, a drive). Nothing else on screen until the dive ends.

vars.theme: clean (deep coral ground, white line) or vice (sunset ground, ink line): the video's theme
vars.game: the game, as logos.json names it (Grand Theft Auto VI)
vars.logo: its logo file: filled from assets/logos/ by build_video.mjs when `game` is listed there
vars.shape: the window's shape: leave it empty, make_scene.mjs makes it from `logo` (logo_shape.mjs: the logo's outline, solid inside, so the gaps between its letters show no slivers of the ground in the window)
vars.logo_cx: the logo's visual centre in logo widths from its image centre (+ = right), so the line centres on the artwork. build_video.mjs fills it from logos.json (cx); with make_scene, pass that cx (GTA VI 0.091)
vars.title: optional: one short line under the logo, the video's subject in the voice's words (34 characters at most); empty = the logo alone
vars.doorx: the dive point, x from the logo's centre in logo widths: a solid part of the logo, so the window grows over the whole frame. build_video.mjs fills doorx, doory and doorr from logos.json (door); with make_scene, pass them (GTA VI: -0.106, -0.039, 0.215)
vars.doory: the dive point, y from the logo's centre in logo widths
vars.doorr: the radius of the solid disc around the dive point, in logo widths. Under 0.05 the logo is a thin wordmark (Max Payne, Bully, The Lost and Damned in logos.json): its window would be a sliver, so open that video with intro-A or intro-C instead
vars.fill: seconds after the start: the artwork fades (9 frames) and the logo becomes a window onto the first shot (1.2)
vars.out: seconds after the start: the dive (9 frames); the scene ends on the first shot 0.33 s later. At least `fill` + 0.6
